weather_refresh_interval_minutes.description: How often the background weather refresh runs, in minutes. WorkManager enforces a 15-minute minimum.

radar_frame_interval_ms.description: Delay between radar animation frames, in milliseconds. Higher is slower. Values outside 100–5000 fall back to 850 in-app.

radar_enabled.description: Hide the radar card if RainViewer or OpenStreetMap tiles become unavailable

walk_card_enabled.description: Show the "time to walk the dog" card on the current-weather screen

open_meteo_enabled.description: Use Open-Meteo for forecasts of cities with coordinates; off falls back to OpenWeatherMap

analytics_enabled.description: Kill switch: false stops all usage-analytics events and turns Firebase Analytics collection off on every install, on top of the user's own Share usage statistics setting.
